contract.api: Plot.spectrum(x, y=None, *, fs REQUIRED, kind=psd, nfft=None, pad_to=None, overlap=0, window=hann, detrend=none, sides=onesided, scaling=density, scale=linear, panel=0, **finite LayerSpec styles)
contract.typed: SpectrumSpec.fs required; optional LayerSpec.spectrum appended after strip; omitted None preserves old schema 0.1 JSON
contract.raw: real finite nonbool plain JSON; no missing-value deletion/resampling/order/ID mutation; equal paired lengths CSD/coherence
contract.units: fs samples/s; frequency Hz; spectrogram elapsed s; density signal²/Hz or cross x*y/Hz; spectrum signal² or x*y; magnitude abs(FFT)/abs(sum(window)); coherence dimensionless; angle/phase radians; explicit user labels preserved
contract.options: boxcar/hann/hamming/blackman symmetric NumPy windows; none/mean/linear detrend before weighting; onesided/twosided; density/spectrum normalization; explicit linear/dB
contract.segmentation: segmented default nfft 256; >=one full window; overlap nonbool integer [0,nfft); trailing partial retained but unused; no short-signal padding; whole magnitude/angle/phase length=len(signal), nfft None overlap 0; pad_to>=window
contract.coherence: >=2 computed full windows; positive consumed-prefix channel scaling before detrend/FFT, then independently positive per-frequency segment-vector scaling before averaged cross/powers; factors cancel analytically; zero-power bins undefined, all undefined rejects; no significance claim or epsilon/clipping; private coherence cross not physical CSD
contract.parity: actual padded FFT M defines Nyquist; DC not doubled, Nyquist not doubled iff M even, other positive bins doubled
contract.phase: exact-zero coefficients undefined gaps; unwrap each defined contiguous run in ascending plotted frequency
contract.csd: normalized complex mean(conj(X)*Y) retained in effect result, magnitude displayed; never serialized raw or fabricated zero phase
contract.zeros: linear power zero valid; dB power 10log10/magnitude20log10 re1 declared unit, zero gaps without floors; all undefined rejects
contract.unsupported: non-Cartesian/projection, non-linear or temporal derived axes, y2, group/semantics/weights/row filters, incompatible derived-unit/raw overlays, unused controls; scaling unused kinds retain density; coherence/phase/angle require linear

resource_caps.units: per-channel rows, effective window and padded FFT, segments*pad_to; before window/FFT allocation; 16MiB per complex128 grid plus other bounded buffers; not SLA/RAM sandbox or old-limit changes

contract.metadata: line label and clabel nonempty strings via shared helper; scalar color uses shared finite named/hex policy; clabel requires spectrogram colourbar; citation/href require line label, shared safe-reference validation and native SVG links/PGF decoration
contract.precision: if channel normalization cannot retain a nonzero used sample, explicit float64 precision error before FFT; trailing partial retained/validated but excluded from scaling
contract.zero_stroke: line_width0 displays no signal stroke via native no-line geometry, exact derived artist data preserved; default/nonzero controls unchanged
